title: BUILD-SITE-031-gse-rating-page-above-fold-redesign
universal_lens: The above-fold redesign formalizes a constrained projection operator mapping high-dimensional proprietary sports intelligence onto a low-dimensional, legally compliant user interface. This structural unification enforces epistemic boundaries, ensuring the public observable manifold strictly decouples from the private methodological subspace while preserving maximum signal-to-noise ratio for rapid cognitive assimilation.
gsi_mapping: Within GSI, this surface acts as a conformal predictive filter. It translates complex Bayesian posterior distributions of sporting outcomes into calibrated confidence intervals and risk-aware visualizations. The mapping guarantees that the presented probabilities maintain strict statistical validity without leaking the underlying generative priors or proprietary calibration algorithms to the end-user.
gse_mapping: For GSE, the page dictates a precise situational state-transition mechanism. User interaction with the rating surface triggers discrete shifts in engagement states—from initial uncertainty to informed action. The design tokens enforce a deterministic transition logic that optimizes retention and conversion metrics while maintaining a robust, casino-free command center aesthetic.

primitives.name: Epistemic Boundary Projection Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Public/Private Boundary Public sees reveal-less explanations, confidence-safe language, and last-verified/source cues where appropriate.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: P: Public observable space (dimensionless UI elements). M: Private methodology space (proprietary algorithmic weights). \pi: Projection operator mapping M \rightarrow P.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes a strict topological separation between the public UI layer and the backend mathematical engine; assumes users require calibrated certainty without access to raw model parameters.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down if the projection operator \pi becomes surjective regarding sensitive priors, resulting in 'method leakage' where the proprietary edge is reverse-engineered from the UI copy.

primitives.name: Compliance Constraint Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Legal / Compliance Boundary No live sportsbook/casino affiliate links, no guaranteed wins, no irresponsible gambling copy, no minors targeting, no legal claims without approval.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: C: Set of all permissible UI states (Boolean compliance flags). L: Regulatory constraint function L: C \rightarrow \{0, 1\}.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes a static, well-defined regulatory environment where prohibited linguistic patterns and link structures can be exhaustively enumerated and filtered.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularities occur when novel marketing copy inadvertently satisfies the syntactic structure of 'guaranteed wins', causing the compliance kernel to reject valid, high-conversion design iterations.

layer2.mapping: Maps directly to the GSE risk-management subsystem, acting as a hard veto on any state transition that violates jurisdictional gambling regulations or ethical AI deployment standards.
layer2.telemetry: Automated copy scan failure rate; number of blocked rendering cycles due to compliance violations.

primitives.name: Signal Hierarchy Manifold
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Design Direction Premium sports intelligence command center: cinematic but fast, high contrast, calm reading states, strong hierarchy, sports-native signal language, no casino/tout feel.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: H: Visual hierarchy metric (inverse seconds to comprehension). S: Signal clarity (contrast ratio). R: Risk perception dampening factor.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes human cognitive processing follows a predictable hierarchy where high-contrast, calm visual states reduce noise and accelerate the extraction of core sporting insights.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails if the pursuit of 'cinematic' aesthetics introduces latency or visual clutter, collapsing the strong hierarchy and increasing the time-to-clarity beyond the critical 10-second threshold.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to the GSE attention-allocation matrix, dynamically weighting visual elements to maximize the user's focus on high-value probabilistic edges rather than superficial gamification.
layer2.telemetry: Time-on-site; 10-second clarity heatmaps; bounce rate reduction on the /intelligence/rating route.

reasoning_traces.think:
The derivation of these primitives begins by modeling the GSE Rating page not merely as a static HTML document, but as a dynamic boundary condition between two distinct epistemic manifolds: the high-dimensional, stochastic reality of sporting events processed by our proprietary models, and the low-dimensional, deterministic constraints of human cognition and legal compliance. The primary operator, Epistemic Boundary Projection, mathematically formalizes the necessity of translating complex posterior probabilities into 'confidence-safe language.' This is not simple rounding; it is a rigorous dimensionality reduction that must preserve the relative ordering of expected values while completely obliterating the trace of the underlying generative priors. If we fail here, we encounter the method leakage singularity, where astute users reverse-engineer our edge.

Simultaneously, the Compliance Constraint Kernel operates as a hard topological filter. In the vector space of all possible marketing communications, there exists a forbidden subspace defined by terms like 'guaranteed wins' or direct casino affiliate vectors. Our design system must project all user-facing text orthogonal to this forbidden subspace. This ensures that the 'premium sports intelligence command center' aesthetic does not accidentally drift into the 'casino/tout' regime, which carries severe legal liabilities and destroys the trust metric we are trying to optimize.

Finally, the Signal Hierarchy Manifold addresses the temporal dynamics of user engagement. We postulate that value extraction is a race against cognitive decay. By enforcing a 'strong hierarchy' and 'calm reading states,' we minimize the entropy of the visual field, allowing the user's attention to lock onto the highest-signal elements within a 10-second window. The dualities here are stark: cinematic appeal versus rendering speed, and absolute transparency versus necessary opacity. The failure mode is a collapse into either sterile utility or deceptive hype, both of which destroy the long-term retention curve. Thus, the redesign is fundamentally an exercise in optimizing a multi-objective Lagrangian under strict inequality constraints.

reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: This framework inherits from Shannon's information theory, specifically the rate-distortion theorem, adapted for behavioral economics. Historically, financial terminal designs (like Bloomberg) pioneered the 'command center' aesthetic to manage high-frequency data overload. We retroactively apply these principles to sports intelligence, recognizing that modern bettors require institutional-grade clarity rather than parlor-game odds, necessitating a shift from opaque toutism to transparent, bounded epistemic authority.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: We model the user as a rational but bandwidth-limited agent seeking to minimize decision fatigue while maximizing perceived edge. Opposing actors include the user's innate cognitive biases toward overconfidence and the regulatory bodies actively scanning for predatory patterns. The design must anticipate the user's skepticism ('no fake certainty') and preemptively neutralize it through grounded, source-cited language, effectively aligning the user's mental model with the actual probabilistic nature of the GSE output without triggering defensive skepticism.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: An anti-collinearity veto is strictly enforced between the 'Design Direction' and the 'Legal Boundary' layers. If a proposed visual hierarchy (e.g., flashing green lights for high-confidence picks) increases conversion but collides with the 'no casino feel' or 'irresponsible gambling' constraints, the compliance kernel must issue an immediate, non-negotiable override. Furthermore, any copy that inadvertently correlates with 'method leakage'—even if legally sound—must be vetoed by the epistemic boundary operator to protect the core intellectual property of the Galaxy Sports Engine.
